faqs.a:
(a)
If temporary service is supplied through a fire hydrant, a permit for the use of the
               hydrant shall be obtained from the department of utilities. It shall be unlawful for
               any person to operate a valve of any fire hydrant, other than by the use of a spanner
               wrench.
(b)
It is unlawful for any person, other than city personnel or members of the fire department,
               to open any fire hydrant, attempt to draw water from it, or in any manner damage or
               tamper with any fire hydrant.
(c)
All authorized private use of fire hydrants shall be metered by use of a construction
               water meter. Unmetered use of fire hydrants by any person except city personnel or
               members of the fire department is unlawful.
(d)
It is unlawful for any person to use a fire hydrant for fire suppression outside of
               the city without the express approval of the city.
(e)
Should the city perform any work or incur any expense for the installation, removal,
               repair, or replacement of a fire hydrant and any such work is caused by any person,
               the city is authorized to recover the actual cost of the work or expense as provided
               in
section 102-41
.
(Code 1981, § 33-43; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988; Ord. No. 2671, § 5, 10-16-1989)
